raw.rationale: This is a launched antihypertensive adrenergic antagonist with no known cytotoxic or antiproliferative mechanism, and PRISM single-agent screens of such drugs typically show no lineage-selective killing above base rates. Therefore probabilities are near the low end of the stated 0.2-2.5% per-lineage base rate, with only minor variation for lineages where adrenergic signaling or transporter expression might marginally influence viability.
